I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands herebydeclare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose andwill be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called “Dawatagahawatta” in total extent ofabout 0.0489 Hectare depicted as Lot ‘A’ in Advance Tracing No.Gam/Gam/2016/159 dated 17.08.2016, prepared by the Surveyor-General situated in the Village of Bendiyamulla in MedapattuwaMinor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Gampahain the District of Gampaha in Western Province and bounded asfollows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Dawatagahawatta – Extent: 0.0489 HectareNorth: Land claimed by the State of which the name of land couldnot be traced; East: Land claimed by the State of which the name of
land could not be traced and Land claimed by Asoka Aberathne ofwhich the name of land could not be traced; South: Road; West: Landclaimed by the State of which the name of land could not be traced.
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands.
